name: rpi-usage
description: Usage lookup: /usage queries the current provider's typed balance, plan quota or subscription windows through the host scripted usage-provider framework (built-in DeepSeek / GLM Coding Plan / MiniMax Token Plan / Kimi Code / OpenCode Go / Anthropic / OpenAI Codex / xAI scripts) and keeps a typed footer status line; --cached/--json/--provider, /usage list/help, local session-token fallback for providers without quota, and user scripts extend it with custom providers
